paragraphs: De Montfort University (DMU) is a public university in Leicester, England, with over 27,000 students. Founded as Leicester School of Art in 1870 and gaining university status in 1992, DMU is best known for design (Fashion, Footwear Design, Game Art), creative industries, business (Leicester Castle Business School), computing, and health (Pharmacy School — top-15 in UK). DMU's flagship city-centre campus surrounds a medieval area including the historic Magazine Square and Leicester Castle.
International students enter via Oxford International pathway programmes — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead into a DMU Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: De Montfort University (DMU) — государственный университет в Лестере, более 27 000 студентов. Основан как Leicester School of Art в 1870, статус университета с 1992. Известен дизайном (Fashion, Footwear Design, Game Art), creative industries, бизнесом (Leicester Castle Business School), computing и фармацией (топ-15 UK). Флагманский city-centre кампус окружает средневековый район с Magazine Square и Leicester Castle.
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру DMU.
